_comment: MLIE_FAUNA_ABSORPTION_1 Wave C. old Mlie defName -> new RSW_ defName. Sibling to mlie_creature_defname_map_wave_a.json (Bantha), mlie_creature_defname_map_wave_b.json (Dewback/Wampa/Acklay/Vulptex/Porg/Nuna), and mlie_sound_defname_map.json (589 SoundDefs). Wave C works off the measured 91-species worklist (infrastructure/state/facts/mlie_wave_c_worklist.json), ported a few species at a time. No wave_c mapping file existed before this entry - the 2026-09-12 Iriaz/Mudhorn pass documented its map only in prose (MLIE_FAUNA_ABSORPTION_1.md's 2026-09-12 section); recorded here retroactively for the same traceability the other waves get, alongside the Anooba/Beldon/Bolotaur pass that created this file.

bodydefs._comment: Iriaz/Mudhorn/Bolotaur use vanilla bodies (QuadrupedAnimalWithHooves, QuadrupedAnimalWithHoovesAndHorn, QuadrupedAnimalWithClawsTailAndJowl) - no port needed. Anooba's/Borcatu's own custom bodies needed only a defName rename (vanilla-part composition). Beldon's custom body needed a full port including its 3 tentacle parts, which reuse Wave B's already-ported RSW_SW_LeftTentacle/RSW_SW_RightTentacle/RSW_SW_DorsalTentacle BodyPartDefs and RSW_SWTentacleAttackTool/RSW_SW_FirstTentacleBeldon/RSW_SW_SecondTentacleBeldon/RSW_SW_ThirdTentacleBeldon BodyPartGroupDefs - no NEW body part needed this wave either. Boma's/CanCell's custom bodies needed a defName rename PLUS repointing to already-ported Wave B BodyPartDefs/Groups (Boma: RSW_SW_LeftHorn/RSW_SW_RightHorn/RSW_SWHornAttackTool/RSW_SWTailAttackTool; CanCell: RSW_SW_LeftWing/RSW_SW_RightWing) - no NEW body part needed either.
bodydefs._comment2: Cannok/Clodhopper pass (2026-09-12, next-3 batch): both custom BodyDefs needed only a defName rename (both are entirely vanilla-part composition, like Anooba/Borcatu) - ported as RSW_Cannok/RSW_Clodhopper (RSW_MlieWaveC_Bodies.xml). Convor uses the vanilla Core FlyingAvian body, no port at all.

rendertreedefs._comment: Beldon needed a new PawnRenderTreeDef (Anomaly-gated) drawing its 3 tentacles via vanilla Anomaly's own PawnRenderNodeProperties_BulbfreakTentacle node class.

abilities._comment: SW_SootheSong (Beldon's Odyssey ability) had no prior-wave port; new AbilityDef/HediffDef/TrainableDef trio, RSW_MlieWaveC_Abilities.xml. Anooba/Bolotaur reuse already-ported Wave B abilities (RSW_SW_Spur for Bolotaur; Anooba needed none, its AttackTarget specialTrainable is vanilla Odyssey content).

thoughts._comment: SoothingSong (RecoveryThought on SW_SootheSong's HediffDef) is donor content from the same Thoughts_Memory_SpecialCuisine.xml as RSW_AteMudhornEgg - ported into the existing RSW_Bantha_Thoughts.xml.

resources._comment: Iriaz needed no new resource (repoints to already-ported RSW_Reptomammal_Meat, Wave B). Bolotaur repoints leather/meat to already-ported RSW_Leather_Saurian/RSW_Saurian_Meat (Wave B) and needed only its 2 eggs newly ported. Anooba repoints specificMeatDef to already-ported RSW_Tough_Meat (Wave B) and needed only its leather newly ported (donor's Leather_ReptoFur was never ported before this pass despite being referenced by other already-ported species' patches, e.g. Armour_Leather.xml). Beldon needed a new meat and 2 new eggs; Mudhorn (this file's earlier entry) needed 2 eggs, a meat, a wool, and a butcher-body-part skull trophy. Boma repoints leather/meat to already-ported RSW_Leather_Saurian/RSW_Saurian_Meat (Wave B, same as Bolotaur) and needed only its 2 eggs newly ported. Borcatu needed a new leather (Leather_Tough) but repoints specificMeatDef to already-ported RSW_Tough_Meat (Wave B, same Tough_Meat Anooba already uses). CanCell needed a new leather AND a new meat (Leather_Insectile / Insectile_Meat) plus its 2 eggs.
resources._comment2: Cannok/Clodhopper/Convor pass (2026-09-12, next-3 batch): Cannok needs no new resource - repoints to the already-ported RSW_Leather_Insectile/RSW_Insectile_Meat (same resources CanCell uses). Clodhopper's leatherDef stays vanilla Core Leather_Bird (not a Mlie resource); specificMeatDef repoints to already-ported RSW_Reptavian_Meat (Wave B); only its 2 eggs are newly ported (texPath swresource/EggSpeckled, newly extracted). Convor's leatherDef/specificMeatDef repoint to already-ported RSW_Leather_Mammavian/RSW_Mammavian_Meat (Wave B); only its 2 eggs are newly ported (texPath swresource/EggSwirl, newly extracted).

not_ported_this_wave._comment: 80 species remain in the measured Wave C worklist after this pass (91 - Iriaz - Mudhorn - Anooba - Beldon - Bolotaur - Boma - Borcatu - CanCell - Cannok - Clodhopper - Convor = 80 remaining). Fambaa (a known Tier B holdout outside the 91-count) is still untouched.

cast_wiring._comment: Both BiomeCast_Ashkarr.xml copies (design/Jawa/fauna/ and deployed src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/Patches/) and cast_assignment.csv updated to repoint the bare donor defName wildAnimals entries to the new RSW_ names, same mechanism as every prior wave. Boma/CanCell reused an EXISTING mandrake.rsw.swbestiary-gated PatchOperationConditional/PatchOperationAdd block was NOT available for their biomes except Boma's (ZBiome_DesertOasis already had one, from Wave A/B) - Borcatu (Wasteland) and CanCell (ZBiome_Badlands) needed a brand NEW mandrake.rsw.swbestiary block each, inserted immediately before the existing mlie.starwarsanimalcollection block for that biome, same MayRequire combination (biome-donor mod + our own packageId) as every other biome-gated block. Removing Borcatu left its Wasteland mlie block with an empty <value> (it was the sole entry) - that now-empty Operation was deleted outright, not left as a hollow no-op, per this repo's 'inaccurate material is deleted' rule. Cannok/Clodhopper/Convor pass (same day, next-3 batch): all 5 target biomes (AridShrubland, Desert, BiomeCypreJungle, COMIGO_GreaterSwamp_Tropical, ZBiome_Badlands) ALREADY had an existing mandrake.rsw.swbestiary-gated block from an earlier wave - no new gated blocks needed this time, just added the 3 new RSW_ entries into the existing gated <value> blocks (ordered by descending commonality, matching the existing convention) and removed the corresponding bare donor-name entries from each biome's mlie.starwarsanimalcollection-gated block. None of the 5 mlie blocks were emptied by the removal (each still has other entries), so no Operation block deletion needed this pass.

patch_file_fixes._comment: Checked all 3 Mlie-touching patch files this item names. BehemothArtUpres_StarWarsAnimalCollection.xml and AnimalDessicatedTexPaths_Fix.xml: 0 references to Anooba/Beldon/Bolotaur, no change needed. AnimalBiomeDuplicates_Fix.xml: found 1 stale reference (Operation #38, 'Anooba x ZBiome_Grasslands (2nd record)') - a PatchOperationConditional/Remove pair deduplicating a donor-mod-added second wildAnimals/Anooba entry in ZBiome_Grasslands. Renaming our own BiomeCast_Ashkarr entry to RSW_Anooba means the two entries are no longer the same dictionary key, so the duplicate-crash risk this block guarded against is gone - the block was REMOVED outright (not just renamed) per this repo's 'inaccurate material is deleted, not superseded-in-place' rule, with a dated header note explaining why. See AnimalBiomeDuplicates_Fix.xml's 2026-09-12 header block. Boma/Borcatu/CanCell pass (same day, next-3 batch): re-checked all 3 files against these 3 new species' donor names - 0 references in any of the 3, no change needed. Cannok/Clodhopper/Convor pass (same day, next-3 batch): AnimalBiomeDuplicates_Fix.xml has one existing Operation (#6, 'Cannok x ExtremeDesert') that removes a duplicate key in the donor Cannok ThingDef's OWN race/wildBiomes/ExtremeDesert field (a per-def duplicate against another mod's biome patch, not a BiomeDef wildAnimals-list duplicate). That operation still targets the donor's unrenamed 'Cannok' ThingDef, which is untouched by this pass (we only added a NEW RSW_Cannok ThingDef with its own copy of that field) and remains live as long as Mlie stays active - not stale, not moot, left unchanged. No other references to Cannok/Clodhopper/Convor found in any of the 3 files.
patch_file_fixes.AnimalBiomeDuplicates_Fix.xml: removed stale Operation #38 (Anooba x ZBiome_Grasslands dedup, now moot); 0 references to Boma/Borcatu/CanCell; 1 unrelated-but-still-valid reference to donor Cannok (Operation #6, ExtremeDesert dedup on the donor's own ThingDef field, left unchanged)
patch_file_fixes.BehemothArtUpres_StarWarsAnimalCollectio: no reference to this wave's species (Anooba/Beldon/Bolotaur/Boma/Borcatu/CanCell/Cannok/Clodhopper/Convor), unchanged
patch_file_fixes.AnimalDessicatedTexPaths_Fix.xml: no reference to this wave's species (Anooba/Beldon/Bolotaur/Boma/Borcatu/CanCell/Cannok/Clodhopper/Convor), unchanged
